nom: MAC Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cream-To-Foam Face Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe it as a good match, citing thorough oil and makeup removal without greasiness, though one notes it deeply cleans and would hesitate to recommend it to dry skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it leaves skin dry, tight, ashy, or stripped, while others report it feels moisturizing and does not dry them out.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it as gentle yet effective, not leaving skin tight and removing makeup well.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation, breakouts, or dryness, with one crediting it for reduced redness, though fragrance is flagged as a risk for this group.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying normal skin reports no drying, with skin left refreshed and soft.
segments.mature: A reviewer with dry, aging skin reports it keeps skin hydrated without stripping.

concerns.aging: One reviewer with dry, aging skin reports it keeps skin hydrated; another attributes the disappearance of a fine line near her mouth to her overall MAC skincare routine including this cleanser, though she is unsure which product caused it.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report the cleanser as hydrating or non-stripping, but a notable minority describe it as drying, leaving skin ashy, tight, or in need of immediate moisturizer, especially those who identify as dry or dehydrated.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin/rosacea reports redness appeared to diminish and skin looked healthier after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer cites an ingredient (glycerin) as helping repair the skin's natural barrier, but this is a single, ingredient-based claim rather than a widely reported outcome.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the cleanser lightened her dark spots; no other reviewer addresses spots or hyperpigmentation directly.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin are mixed: several report no new breakouts and skin looking clearer, while others explicitly warn it is not formulated for acne-prone skin and one reviewer with acne states she would not use it as an everyday cleanser for that concern.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it removes excess oil and grease effectively and does not leave skin greasy; no reports of oiliness increasing.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way
Screw-top cap awkward with wet hands
High price for a basic cleanser

extraits.texte: This smells like Ivory Soap and straps my face just like it. This left me with that unpleasant squeaky clean face. I'm super dry and dehydrated so I have no oils to spare. Save your face and skip this

I have really been enjoying this cleanser. It really does seem to cleanse the skin without stripping! It is the holy grail of cream cleansers and keeps my dry, aging skin hydrated. think I might finally be a product monogamist.

I got this as a sample when buying something from MAC. I was hestiant to try it because I have sensitive skin/rosacea and generally have a bad reaction to products. I decided to be brave and give it a try. Boy am I happy I did. My skin looks amazing. The redness seems to have disipated and my skin looks healthier and nourished. Highly recommend to anyone with sensitive skin.

This cleanser really deep cleansing and takes away all oil, dirt, makeup, pollutants off your skin. This cleanser is no joke. It's excellent for oily greasy skin, but I would be a little nervous to recommend to someone with dry skin. I love this cleanser
Honestly this is the best product I have ever tried on my face, I'm acne prone and this is about the only cleanser that hasn't broken me out! And it smells so good!

This is easily one of the best cleansers that I've ever used. My skin tends to be on the dryer side and a lot of face cleansers dry out my skin even more. I am constantly trying new cleansers, because the big name brands tend to leave me with small, dry patches on my face. I also tend to develop whiteheads easily, especially on my nose. I usually apply a toner after cleansing to help prevent them, but I decided to test this MAC cleanser by itself to see if it would have an effect. I have been using this cleanser for two weeks and I can already see some improvements with my skin. My face doesn't feel nearly as dry when I'm finished cleansing. As a result, I can apply a little less moisturizer. The cleanser itself almost feels like it's adding moisturizer. It is a nice cream that glides on to the skin. It removes any dirt and debris form my face without stripping away all of the natural oils. My face just feels fresher and smoother after using this cleanser. I do not wear makeup, so I do not have a lot of experience with MAC products, but after trying this cleanser, I am excited to explore more of their skincare line.

The reason I've titled this review 'to each their own' is because it truly depends what your preferences are.. if you have acne prone skin and you are looking for non-acnegenic then skip this (Myristic Acid, Lauric acid, Algae Extract) If fragrances irritate you .. be weary . (ALTHOUGH IT SMELLS AMAZING) But is it a good cleanser? ABSOLUTELY , it makes you feel like you have a blank canvas and like it has done its job to clean and cleanse. It has other ingredients that are good, that do promote repairing of the barrier and even skin tone over time. So for the right candidate; oily skin, combo skin.. those in the market for something new …. DONT HESITATE!
